verdict.rationale: Trivy documents lock-file based scanning (e.g., Gemfile.lock, package-lock.json) across filesystem targets, plus container image, IaC, secret, and license scanning, and community feedback confirms broad practical usage across CI/CD pipelines. However, the evidence pack doesn't enumerate the full breadth of language/package ecosystems supported (e.g., no explicit list covering Go, Python, Java, Rust, PHP, etc.) and one community report notes a crash on a specific scan type (AWS), suggesting some rough edges. missing for 10: an exhaustive list of supported language ecosystems/lock files, and stronger independent verification of accuracy across all ecosystems.
